tasks.label: 설치: 가상환경 + 패키지
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && cp -n .env.example .env || true

tasks.label: Part 1 · Docker Ollama 기동 (11435)
tasks.command: docker compose -f part1/docker/compose.ollama.yaml up -d && sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:11435/v1/models

tasks.label: Part 1 · Docker 정리
tasks.command: docker compose -f part1/docker/compose.ollama.yaml down; docker compose -f part1/docker/compose.vllm.yaml down

tasks.label: Part 1 · kind 클러스터 + 매니페스트 적용
tasks.command: kind create cluster --name kant --config part1/k8s/kind-config.yaml; kubectl apply -f part1/k8s/ && sleep 5 && kubectl get pods -o wide

tasks.label: Part 1 · GPU Pod Pending 이유 보기
Part 1 · terraform plan (비용 없음)
tasks.command: cd part1/terraform && terraform init -input=false && terraform validate && terraform plan

tasks.label: Part 2 · Ollama 모델 GPU 에서 내리기 (vLLM 전)
tasks.command: ollama ps; for m in $(ollama ps | awk 'NR>1{print $1}'); do ollama stop $m; done; ollama ps
